indeterminate.finding: `test_generated_criteria_guide_is_in_parity` claims editing the prompts without regenerating 'leaves the shipped guide contradicting the rubric the model actually runs', but `registry.validate_criteria_guide` only verifies section-ID parity (every CANONICAL_LLM criterion has a `## <id>` section and no orphan sections) — it does not compare the guide's rendered TEXT against the prompt bodies.
